description: Plan the product image set for one market: the marketplace's main-image rules (Amazon, Rakuten, Tmall, Shopee, TikTok Shop…), a 7-image gallery (real main image, local lifestyle, texture, how-to, benefits infographic, scale, trust) with edit-from-packshot prompts for treg.to image models, ad sizes per platform, AI and claims rules, and the estimated cost. Free, read-only.

country.description: Target country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. 'US', 'JP') or an English/Korean name.

item.description: Product as an HS4 code (e.g. '3304') or a name in English or Korean (e.g. 'sunscreen', '라면'). Names cover TradeGraph's 35 items; any other product works as a 4-digit HS code (e.g. '1905' biscuits, '2005' kimchi, '3305' shampoo) with live UN Comtrade imports. Optional; sets the product group.

marketplace.description: Optional marketplace, e.g. 'amazon', 'rakuten', 'shopee'; defaults to the market's main one.

product.description: The product in plain English as it looks.

name: image_studio
title: Marketplace and ad images for a market
